name: Anchor-2D-GS / Anchor-3D-GS
definition: Modified versions of 2D-GS and 3D-GS that employ an anchor grid structure to organize Gaussian primitives more efficiently, reducing redundancy and storage overhead.
summary: Anchor-2D-GS and Anchor-3D-GS are modified Gaussian splatting methods that use an anchor grid to organize primitives, reducing redundancy and storage overhead while maintaining competitive rendering quality.
